/-! ## Search -/

kanidm_kernel.Properties.search_attrs_gr.statement:
/-- Every attribute a search returns on an entry is granted on that entry by a
search profile that applies to the caller, or is one of the few attributes
the OAuth2, application and sync-account rules release. -/
theorem search_attrs_granted (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (se : SearchEvent) (es : Slice Entry)
    (rs : alloc.vec.Vec EntryReduced) (r : EntryReduced) (x : Ava)
    (h : access.search_filter_entry_attributes ctl se es = ok (.Ok rs))
    (hr : r ∈ rs.val) (hx : x ∈ r.attrs.val) :
    ∃ e ∈ es.val, e.uuid = r.uuid ∧ x ∈ e.attrs.val ∧ SearchGrants ctl se.ident e (nats x.attr.val) := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredSearchAttrsGranted.search_attrs_granted <;> assumption

kanidm_kernel.Properties.anonymous_reads.statement:
/-- The anonymous user gets nothing from the OAuth2 and application rules: what
it may read comes from the profiles alone. -/
theorem anonymous_reads_by_profile_only (ident : Identity) (u : IdentUser)
    (related : Slice profiles.AccessControlSearchResolved) (e : Entry)
    (attrs : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (x : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (hu : ident.origin = .User u) (ha : u.entry.uuid = UUID_ANONYMOUS)
    (hs : ¬ HasClass u.entry "sync_object")
    (h : search_acc.apply_search_access ident related e = ok (.Allow attrs)) (hx : x ∈ attrs.val) :
    ∃ acs ∈ related.val, x ∈ acs.attrs.val := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredAnonymousReadsByProfileOnly.anonymous_reads_by_profile_only <;> assumption

kanidm_kernel.Properties.synchronise_see.statement:
/-- A sync agreement, or a user session scoped to synchronisation, sees no
entries. -/
theorem synchronise_sees_nothing (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ident : Identity) (f : FilterComp)
    (es : Slice Entry) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Entry)
    (hs : (IsUser ident ∧ ident.scope = .Synchronise) ∨ ∃ s, ident.origin = .Synch s)
    (h : access.filter_entries ctl ident f es = ok (.Ok out)) :
    out.val = [] := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.KanidmSynchroniseSeesNothing.synchronise_sees_nothing <;> assumption

kanidm_kernel.Properties.readonly_cannot.statement:

theorem readonly_cannot_modify (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (b : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser me.ident) (hs : me.ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) (hne : es.val ≠ [])

kanidm_kernel.Properties.delete_needs_pr.statement:
/-- A user deletes an entry only through a delete profile that applies to it. -/
theorem delete_needs_profile (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (de : DeleteEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hu : IsUser de.ident) (h : access.delete_allow_operation ctl de es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    ∃ acd ∈ ctl.acps_delete.val, Applies de.ident acd.acp e := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredDeleteNeedsProfile.delete_needs_profile <;> assumption

kanidm_kernel.Properties.create_needs_pr.statement:
/-- A user creates an entry only through a create profile with a group
receiver that covers the user, whose target matches the entry, and which
allows every attribute and class of the entry. -/
theorem create_needs_profile (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ce : CreateEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hu : IsUser ce.ident) (h : access.create_allow_operation ctl ce es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    ∃ acc ∈ ctl.acps_create.val,
      (∃ gs, acc.acp.receiver = .Group gs) ∧ Applies ce.ident acc.acp e ∧
      (∀ a ∈ e.attrs.val, a.attr ∈ acc.attrs.val) ∧ (∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∈ names acc.classes.val) := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredCreateNeedsProfile.create_needs_profile <;> assumption

kanidm_kernel.Properties.modify_needs_pr.statement:
/-- A user modification asks to set an attribute only where some modify
profile that applies to the entry allows it. -/
theorem modify_needs_profile (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (m : Modify) (a : List Nat)
    (hu : IsUser me.ident) (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok true))
    (he : e ∈ es.val) (hm : m ∈ me.modlist.val) (ha : presAttr m = some a) :
    ∃ acm ∈ ctl.acps_modify.val, a ∈ names acm.presattrs.val ∧ Applies me.ident acm.acp e := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredModifyNeedsProfile.modify_needs_profile <;> assumption

kanidm_kernel.Properties.delete_protecte.statement:

    (h : access.delete_allow_operation ctl de es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :

kanidm_kernel.Properties.sync_object_con.statement:

session and credential-reset attributes and those the agreement yields; an
entry with no single sync parent cannot be modified at all. -/

    (m : Modify) (a : List Nat)

      nats x.attr.val ∈ ["class", "delete_after", "displayname", "mail", "name", "uuid"].map lit) ∧
    ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∈ ["object", "account_signup_request"].map lit := by

    entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e (.Eq a v) = ok true ↔

  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredMatchEqSpec.match_eq_spec <;> assumption

/-! ## Totality -/

kanidm_kernel.Properties.effective_permi.statement:
/-- The effective-permission report (search, modify and delete decisions for
every entry) never panics, overflows or loops, when the access profiles and
sync agreements list fewer than `Usize.max - 73` attributes and classes in total
(the kernel's search, migration, create and modify modules insert 73 distinct
fixed attribute and class names of their own into the same grant sets). Without the bound, two
search profiles granting `Usize.max + 1` distinct attributes overflow the
union of their grants; Rust cannot hold that many distinct strings. -/
theorem effective_permission_check_total (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ident : Identity)
    (attrs : Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))) (es : Slice Entry)
    (hcap : (ctl.acps_search.val.map (·.attrs.length)).sum +
      (ctl.acps_modify.val.map (fun m => m.presattrs.length + m.remattrs.length +
        m.pres_classes.length + m.rem_classes.length)).sum +
      (ctl.sync_agreements.val.map (·.attrs.length)).sum + 73 < Usize.max) :
    ∃ y, access.effective_permission_check ctl ident attrs es = ok y := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredEffectivePermissionCheckTotal.effective_permission_check_total <;> assumption

pub fn validate_partialvalue(
        &self,
        a: &Attribute,
        v: &PartialValue,
    ) -> Result<(), SchemaError> {
        let r = match self.syntax {
            SyntaxType::Boolean => matches!(v, PartialValue::Bool(_)),
            SyntaxType::SyntaxId => matches!(v, PartialValue::Syntax(_)),
            SyntaxType::IndexId => matches!(v, PartialValue::Index(_)),
            SyntaxType::Uuid => matches!(v, PartialValue::Uuid(_)),
            SyntaxType::ReferenceUuid => matches!(v, PartialValue::Refer(_)),
            SyntaxType::Utf8StringInsensitive => matches!(v, PartialValue::Iutf8(_)),
            SyntaxType::Utf8StringIname => matches!(v, PartialValue::Iname(_)),
            SyntaxType::Utf8String => matches!(v, PartialValue::Utf8(_)),
            SyntaxType::JsonFilter => matches!(v, PartialValue::JsonFilt(_)),
            SyntaxType::Credential => matches!(v, PartialValue::Cred(_)),
            SyntaxType::SecretUtf8String => matches!(v, PartialValue::SecretValue),
            SyntaxType::SshKey => matches!(v, PartialValue::SshKey(_)),
            SyntaxType::SecurityPrincipalName => matches!(v, PartialValue::Spn(_, _)),
            SyntaxType::Uint32 => matches!(v, PartialValue::Uint32(_)),
            SyntaxType::Int64 => matches!(v, PartialValue::Int64(_)),
            SyntaxType::Uint64 => matches!(v, PartialValue::Uint64(_)),
            SyntaxType::Cid => matches!(v, PartialValue::Cid(_)),
            SyntaxType::NsUniqueId => matches!(v, PartialValue::Nsuniqueid(_)),
            SyntaxType::DateTime => matches!(v, PartialValue::DateTime(_)),
            SyntaxType::EmailAddress => matches!(v, PartialValue::EmailAddress(_)),
            SyntaxType::Url => matches!(v, PartialValue::Url(_)),
            SyntaxType::OauthScope => matches!(v, PartialValue::OauthScope(_)),
            SyntaxType::OauthScopeMap => matches!(v, PartialValue::Refer(_)),
            SyntaxType::OauthClaimMap => {
                matches!(v, PartialValue::Iutf8(_))
                    || matches!(v, PartialValue::Refer(_))
                    || matches!(v, PartialValue::OauthClaimValue(_, _, _))
                    || matches!(v, PartialValue::OauthClaim(_, _))
            }
            SyntaxType::PrivateBinary => matches!(v, PartialValue::PrivateBinary),
            SyntaxType::IntentToken => matches!(v, PartialValue::IntentToken(_)),
            SyntaxType::Passkey => matches!(v, PartialValue::Passkey(_)),
            SyntaxType::AttestedPasskey => matches!(v, PartialValue::AttestedPasskey(_)),
            // Allow refer types.
            SyntaxType::Session => matches!(v, PartialValue::Refer(_)),
            SyntaxType::ApiToken => matches!(v, PartialValue::Refer(_)),
            SyntaxType::Oauth2Session => matches!(v, PartialValue::Refer(_)),
            // These are just insensitive string lookups on the hex-ified kid.
            SyntaxType::JwsKeyEs256 => matches!(v, PartialValue::Iutf8(_)),
            SyntaxType::JwsKeyRs256 => matches!(v, PartialValue::Iutf8(_)),
            SyntaxType::UiHint => matches!(v, PartialValue::UiHint(_)),
            SyntaxType::EcKeyPrivate => matches!(v, PartialValue::SecretValue),
            // Comparing on the label.
            SyntaxType::TotpSecret => matches!(v, PartialValue::Utf8(_)),
            SyntaxType::AuditLogString => matches!(v, PartialValue::Utf8(_)),
            SyntaxType::Image => matches!(v, PartialValue::Utf8(_)),
            SyntaxType::CredentialType => matches!(v, PartialValue::CredentialType(_)),

            SyntaxType::HexString | SyntaxType::Certificate | SyntaxType::KeyInternal => {
                matches!(v, PartialValue::HexString(_))
            }

            SyntaxType::WebauthnAttestationCaList => false,
            SyntaxType::ApplicationPassword => {
                matches!(v, PartialValue::Uuid(_)) || matches!(v, PartialValue::Refer(_))
            }
            SyntaxType::Sha256 => matches!(v, PartialValue::Sha256(_)),
            // SyntaxType::Json => matches!(v, PartialValue::Json),
            // Should not be queried
            SyntaxType::Json | SyntaxType::Message => false,
        };
        if r {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            error!(
                ?a,
                ?self,
                ?v,
                "validate_partialvalue InvalidAttributeSyntax"
            );
            Err(SchemaError::InvalidAttributeSyntax(a.to_string()))
        }
    }

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result kanidm_kernel kanidm_kernel.Spec

namespace kanidm_kernel.Properties

/-! ## Deny overrides allow -/

/-- When the protection rules deny a modification, no profile can allow it. -/
theorem protected_deny_overrides_modify (ident : Identity)
    (related : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved) (sa : Slice SyncAgreement) (e : Entry)
    (h : modify_acc.modify_protected_attrs ident e = ok .Deny) :
    modify_acc.apply_modify_access ident related sa e = ok .Deny := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredProtectedDenyOverridesModify.protected_deny_overrides_modify <;> assumption

/-- When the protection rules deny a create, no profile can allow it. -/
theorem protected_deny_overrides_create (ident : Identity)
    (related : Slice profiles.AccessControlCreateResolved) (e : Entry)
    (h : create_acc.protected_filter_entry ident e = ok .Deny) :
    create_acc.apply_create_access ident related e = ok .Deny := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredProtectedDenyOverridesCreate.protected_deny_overrides_create <;> assumption

/-! ## Search -/

/-- Every attribute a search returns on an entry is granted on that entry by a
search profile that applies to the caller, or is one of the few attributes
the OAuth2, application and sync-account rules release. -/
theorem search_attrs_granted (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (se : SearchEvent) (es : Slice Entry)
    (rs : alloc.vec.Vec EntryReduced) (r : EntryReduced) (x : Ava)
    (h : access.search_filter_entry_attributes ctl se es = ok (.Ok rs))
    (hr : r ∈ rs.val) (hx : x ∈ r.attrs.val) :
    ∃ e ∈ es.val, e.uuid = r.uuid ∧ x ∈ e.attrs.val ∧ SearchGrants ctl se.ident e (nats x.attr.val) := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredSearchAttrsGranted.search_attrs_granted <;> assumption

/-- The anonymous user gets nothing from the OAuth2 and application rules: what
it may read comes from the profiles alone. -/
theorem anonymous_reads_by_profile_only (ident : Identity) (u : IdentUser)
    (related : Slice profiles.AccessControlSearchResolved) (e : Entry)
    (attrs : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (x : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (hu : ident.origin = .User u) (ha : u.entry.uuid = UUID_ANONYMOUS)
    (hs : ¬ HasClass u.entry "sync_object")
    (h : search_acc.apply_search_access ident related e = ok (.Allow attrs)) (hx : x ∈ attrs.val) :
    ∃ acs ∈ related.val, x ∈ acs.attrs.val := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredAnonymousReadsByProfileOnly.anonymous_reads_by_profile_only <;> assumption

/-- A sync agreement, or a user session scoped to synchronisation, sees no
entries. -/
theorem synchronise_sees_nothing (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ident : Identity) (f : FilterComp)
    (es : Slice Entry) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Entry)
    (hs : (IsUser ident ∧ ident.scope = .Synchronise) ∨ ∃ s, ident.origin = .Synch s)
    (h : access.filter_entries ctl ident f es = ok (.Ok out)) :
    out.val = [] := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.KanidmSynchroniseSeesNothing.synchronise_sees_nothing <;> assumption

/-! ## Write operations need a profile -/

/-- A user session that is not read-write modifies nothing. -/
theorem readonly_cannot_modify (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (b : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser me.ident) (hs : me.ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) (hne : es.val ≠ [])
    (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok b)) :
    b = false := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.KanidmReadonlyCannotModify.readonly_cannot_modify <;> assumption

/-- A user deletes an entry only through a delete profile that applies to it. -/
theorem delete_needs_profile (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (de : DeleteEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hu : IsUser de.ident) (h : access.delete_allow_operation ctl de es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    ∃ acd ∈ ctl.acps_delete.val, Applies de.ident acd.acp e := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredDeleteNeedsProfile.delete_needs_profile <;> assumption

/-- A user creates an entry only through a create profile with a group
receiver that covers the user, whose target matches the entry, and which
allows every attribute and class of the entry. -/
theorem create_needs_profile (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ce : CreateEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hu : IsUser ce.ident) (h : access.create_allow_operation ctl ce es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    ∃ acc ∈ ctl.acps_create.val,
      (∃ gs, acc.acp.receiver = .Group gs) ∧ Applies ce.ident acc.acp e ∧
      (∀ a ∈ e.attrs.val, a.attr ∈ acc.attrs.val) ∧ (∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∈ names acc.classes.val) := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredCreateNeedsProfile.create_needs_profile <;> assumption

/-- A user modification asks to set an attribute only where some modify
profile that applies to the entry allows it. -/
theorem modify_needs_profile (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (m : Modify) (a : List Nat)
    (hu : IsUser me.ident) (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok true))
    (he : e ∈ es.val) (hm : m ∈ me.modlist.val) (ha : presAttr m = some a) :
    ∃ acm ∈ ctl.acps_modify.val, a ∈ names acm.presattrs.val ∧ Applies me.ident acm.acp e := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredModifyNeedsProfile.modify_needs_profile <;> assumption

/-! ## Protected entries -/

/-- Users and migrations never delete builtin entries (uuid at or below
anonymous's) or entries of a protected class. -/
theorem delete_protected (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (de : DeleteEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser de.ident ∨ de.ident.origin = .Internal .Migration)
    (h : access.delete_allow_operation ctl de es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    UUID_ANONYMOUS < e.uuid ∧ ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.KanidmDeleteProtected.delete_protected <;> assumption

/-- Users and migrations never create builtin entries or entries of a
protected class. -/
theorem create_protected (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ce : CreateEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (hk : IsUser ce.ident ∨ ce.ident.origin = .Internal .Migration)
    (h : access.create_allow_operation ctl ce es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    (∀ u, uuidOf e = some u → UUID_ANONYMOUS < u) ∧ ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedEntryClasses := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredCreateProtected.create_protected <;> assumption

/-- Only the internal system identity modifies a tombstone. -/
theorem tombstone_locked (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry) (b : Bool)
    (hn : me.ident.origin ≠ .Internal .System) (he : e ∈ es.val) (ht : HasClass e "tombstone")
    (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok b)) :
    b = false := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredTombstoneLocked.tombstone_locked <;> assumption

/-- Only the internal system identity adds a protected class to an entry. -/
theorem protected_class_never_added (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry)
    (a : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (v : PartialValue) (c : List Nat)
    (hn : me.ident.origin ≠ .Internal .System) (hne : es.val ≠ [])
    (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok true))
    (hm : .Present a v ∈ me.modlist.val) (hc : nats a.val = lit "class") (hv : strOf v = some c) :
    c ∉ protectedModPresClasses := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredProtectedClassNeverAdded.protected_class_never_added <;> assumption

/-! ## Synchronised entries -/

/-- On an unprotected entry owned by a sync agreement, a user may only set the
session and credential-reset attributes and those the agreement yields; an
entry with no single sync parent cannot be modified at all. -/
theorem sync_object_constrained (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (e : Entry)
    (m : Modify) (a : List Nat)
    (hu : IsUser me.ident) (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok true))
    (he : e ∈ es.val) (hs : HasClass e "sync_object")
    (hb : UUID_ANONYMOUS < e.uuid) (hp : ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∉ protectedModEntryClasses)
    (hm : m ∈ me.modlist.val) (ha : presAttr m = some a) :
    ∃ p, refers e "sync_parent_uuid" = some [p] ∧ (a ∈ syncAttrs ∨ a ∈ agreementAttrs ctl.sync_agreements.val p) := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredSyncObjectConstrained.sync_object_constrained <;> assumption

/-! ## Internal identities -/

/-- The account-request identity creates only sign-up requests, with only
their six attributes. -/
theorem account_request_creates_signups (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ce : CreateEvent) (es : Slice Entry)
    (e : Entry)
    (hr : ce.ident.origin = .Internal .AccountRequest)
    (h : access.create_allow_operation ctl ce es = ok (.Ok true)) (he : e ∈ es.val) :
    (∀ x ∈ e.attrs.val,
      nats x.attr.val ∈ ["class", "delete_after", "displayname", "mail", "name", "uuid"].map lit) ∧
    ∀ c ∈ classes e, c ∈ ["object", "account_signup_request"].map lit := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredAccountRequestCreatesSignups.account_request_creates_signups <;> assumption

/-! ## The filter matcher -/

/-- An equality term matches exactly when the entry's value set for the
attribute holds the value. -/
theorem match_eq_spec (e : Entry) (a : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (v : PartialValue) :
    entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e (.Eq a v) = ok true ↔
      ∃ vs, ava e (nats a.val) = some vs ∧ ValueContains vs v := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredMatchEqSpec.match_eq_spec <;> assumption

/-- The substring test of `Cnt` terms is `List.IsInfix`. -/
theorem str_contains_spec (hay needle : Slice U8) :
    valueset.str_contains hay needle = ok (decide (needle.val <:+: hay.val)) := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredStrContainsSpec.str_contains_spec <;> assumption

/-! ## Totality -/

/-- The effective-permission report (search, modify and delete decisions for
every entry) never panics, overflows or loops, when the access profiles and
sync agreements list fewer than `Usize.max - 73` attributes and classes in total
(the kernel's search, migration, create and modify modules insert 73 distinct
fixed attribute and class names of their own into the same grant sets). Without the bound, two
search profiles granting `Usize.max + 1` distinct attributes overflow the
union of their grants; Rust cannot hold that many distinct strings. -/

      (ctl.acps_modify.val.map (fun m => m.presattrs.length + m.remattrs.length +
        m.pres_classes.length + m.rem_classes.length)).sum +
      (ctl.sync_agreements.val.map (·.attrs.length)).sum + 73 < Usize.max) :
    ∃ y, access.effective_permission_check ctl ident attrs es = ok y := by
  apply kanidm_kernel.Verified.RecoveredEffectivePermissionCheckTotal.effective_permission_check_total <;> assumption

Spec.code:
import KanidmKernel
import H5iAppLib
/-!
# kanidm's access control engine: the spec

From kanidm's access module at f608c4f (`server/lib/src/server/access/`)
and its design notes (`book/src/developers/designs/access_profiles_original.md`).
An access control profile applies to an identity and an entry when its
receiver covers the identity and its target filter, resolved for the
identity, matches the entry. The theorems use the extracted filter resolver
and matcher for the target (`TargetHolds`); `match_eq_spec` and
`str_contains_spec` describe the matcher's pieces on their own.
-/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std kanidm_kernel

namespace kanidm_kernel.Spec

/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

/-- The UTF-8 bytes of a literal. -/
def lit (s : String) : List Nat := s.toUTF8.toList.map (·.toNat)

/-- Attribute or class names. -/
def names (v : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) : List (List Nat) := v.map (fun x => nats x.val)

/-- The value set of the entry's attribute `a` (the first pair with that name). -/
def ava (e : Entry) (a : List Nat) : Option ValueSet :=
  (e.attrs.val.find? (fun x => nats x.attr.val == a)).map (·.vs)

/-- The entry's classes: its `class` attribute when it is a case-insensitive
string set, else none. -/
def classes (e : Entry) : List (List Nat) :=
  match ava e (lit "class") with
  | some (.Iutf8 s) => names s.val
  | _ => []

def HasClass (e : Entry) (c : String) : Prop := lit c ∈ classes e

/-- The uuids of a reference attribute. -/
def refers (e : Entry) (a : String) : Option (List U128) :=
  match ava e (lit a) with
  | some (.Refer s) => some s.val
  | _ => none

/-- The uuid of an entry being created: its `uuid` attribute, when single. -/
def uuidOf (e : Entry) : Option U128 :=
  match ava e (lit "uuid") with
  | some (.Uuid s) => if s.val.length = 1 then s.val.head? else none
  | _ => none

def IsUser (i : Identity) : Prop := ∃ u, i.origin = .User u

/-- The groups a user identity is a member of. -/
def memberof (i : Identity) : List U128 :=
  match i.origin with
  | .User u => (refers u.entry "memberof").getD []
  | _ => []

/-- The receiver of a profile covers the identity for this entry: a member of
one of its groups, or, for an entry-manager profile, the entry's manager or a
member of a managing group. -/
def ReceiverHolds (i : Identity) (r : profiles.AccessControlReceiver) (e : Entry) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | .None => False
  | .Group gs => ∃ g ∈ memberof i, g ∈ gs.val
  | .EntryManager =>
    ∃ ms, refers e "entry_managed_by" = some ms ∧
      ((∃ u, i.origin = .User u ∧ u.entry.uuid ∈ ms) ∨ ∃ g ∈ memberof i, g ∈ ms)

/-- The target filter, resolved for the identity, matches the entry. -/
def TargetHolds (i : Identity) (t : profiles.AccessControlTarget) (e : Entry) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | .None => False
  | .Scope f => ∃ fr, filter_impl.resolve f i = .ok (some fr) ∧ entry_impl.entry_match_no_index e fr = .ok true

/-- The profile applies to the identity and the entry. -/
def Applies (i : Identity) (p : profiles.AccessControlProfile) (e : Entry) : Prop :=
  ReceiverHolds i p.receiver e ∧ TargetHolds i p.target e

/-- What the OAuth2, application and sync-account modules may release, without
a profile. -/
def fixedSearchAttrs : List (List Nat) :=
  ["class", "displayname", "uuid", "name", "oauth2_rs_origin_landing", "image", "linked_group",
   "sync_credential_portal"].map lit

/-- Some search profile that applies grants attribute `a` on `e`, or `a` is one
of the fixed attributes. -/
def SearchGrants (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (i : Identity) (e : Entry) (a : List Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ acs ∈ ctl.acps_search.val, a ∈ names acs.attrs.val ∧ Applies i acs.acp e) ∨ a ∈ fixedSearchAttrs

/-- `PROTECTED_ENTRY_CLASSES`: may not be created or deleted. -/
def protectedEntryClasses : List (List Nat) :=
  ["system", "domain_info", "system_info", "system_config", "dyngroup", "sync_object", "tombstone",
   "recycled"].map lit

/-- `PROTECTED_MOD_ENTRY_CLASSES`. -/
def protectedModEntryClasses : List (List Nat) :=
  ["system", "domain_info", "system_info", "system_config", "dyngroup", "tombstone", "recycled"].map lit

/-- `PROTECTED_MOD_PRES_ENTRY_CLASSES`: may not be added to any entry. -/
def protectedModPresClasses : List (List Nat) := protectedEntryClasses

/-- The attribute a modification asks to make present (`requested_pres`). -/
def presAttr : Modify → Option (List Nat)
  | .Present a _ | .Set a _ | .Assert a _ => some (nats a.val)
  | .Removed _ _ | .Purged _ => none

/-- `Value::to_str`. -/
def strOf : PartialValue → Option (List Nat)
  | .Utf8 s | .Iutf8 s | .Iname s => some (nats s.val)
  | _ => none

/-- What a user may always change on a synchronised entry. -/
def syncAttrs : List (List Nat) :=
  ["user_auth_token_session", "oauth2_session", "oauth2_consent_scope_map",
   "credential_update_intent_token"].map lit

/-- The attributes the sync agreement `u` yields to kanidm. -/
def agreementAttrs (sa : List SyncAgreement) (u : U128) : List (List Nat) :=
  match sa.find? (fun a => a.uuid == u) with
  | some a => names a.attrs.val
  | none => []

/-- The value set holds the value (`ValueSetT::contains`). -/
def ValueContains : ValueSet → PartialValue → Prop
  | .Utf8 s, .Utf8 x => x ∈ s.val
  | .Iutf8 s, .Iutf8 x => x ∈ s.val
  | .Iname s, .Iname x => x ∈ s.val
  | .Uuid s, .Uuid u => u ∈ s.val
  | .Refer s, .Refer u => u ∈ s.val
  | .Uint32 s, .Uint32 n => n ∈ s.val
  | .OauthScopeMap s, .Refer u => u ∈ s.val
  | _, _ => False

end kanidm_kernel.Spec

import KanidmKernel
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result kanidm_kernel
open Aeneas.Std.WP H5iAppLib
namespace kanidm_kernel.Verified.AccountPolicy

private theorem if_ok {α : Type} (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (a b : α) :
    (if p then ok a else ok b) = (ok (if p then a else b) : Result α) := by
  split <;> rfl

def maxOption (a b : Option U64) : Option U64 :=
  match a, b with
  | none, x | x, none => x
  | some x, some y => some (max x y)

theorem option_max_spec (a b : Option U64) :
    account_policy.option_max a b = ok (maxOption a b) := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [account_policy.option_max, maxOption, max_def]
  split <;> split <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

def conjunction (a b : Option Bool) : Option Bool :=
  match a, b with
  | none, x | x, none => x
  | some x, some y => some (x && y)

def combine (a b : account_policy.Policy) : account_policy.Policy :=
  { privilege_expiry := min a.privilege_expiry b.privilege_expiry,
    authsession_expiry := min a.authsession_expiry b.authsession_expiry,
    pw_min_length := max a.pw_min_length b.pw_min_length,
    credential_policy := max a.credential_policy b.credential_policy,
    limit_search_max_filter_test := maxOption a.limit_search_max_filter_test b.limit_search_max_filter_test,
    limit_search_max_results := maxOption a.limit_search_max_results b.limit_search_max_results,
    allow_primary_cred_fallback := conjunction a.allow_primary_cred_fallback b.allow_primary_cred_fallback }

theorem combine_spec (a b : account_policy.Policy) :
    account_policy.combine a b = ok (combine a b) := by
  have hpriv : (if b.privilege_expiry < a.privilege_expiry then b.privilege_expiry else a.privilege_expiry) = min a.privilege_expiry b.privilege_expiry := by
    simp [min_def]; split <;> split <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac
  have hauth : (if b.authsession_expiry < a.authsession_expiry then b.authsession_expiry else a.authsession_expiry) = min a.authsession_expiry b.authsession_expiry := by
    simp [min_def]; split <;> split <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac
  have hpw : (if b.pw_min_length > a.pw_min_length then b.pw_min_length else a.pw_min_length) = max a.pw_min_length b.pw_min_length := by
    simp [max_def]; split <;> split <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac
  have hcred : (if b.credential_policy > a.credential_policy then b.credential_policy else a.credential_policy) = max a.credential_policy b.credential_policy := by
    simp [max_def]; split <;> split <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac
  unfold account_policy.combine
  simp only [if_ok, bind_ok, option_max_spec]
  rw [hpriv, hauth, hpw, hcred]
  cases ha : a.allow_primary_cred_fallback <;> cases hb : b.allow_primary_cred_fallback <;>
    simp [combine, conjunction, ha, hb]
  split <;> simp_all

def finalize (a : account_policy.Policy) : account_policy.Resolved :=
  { policy := if a.credential_policy < 10#u16 then
      {a with pw_min_length := max a.pw_min_length 15#u32} else a,
    pw_max_length := 128#u32 }

theorem finalize_spec (a : account_policy.Policy) :
    account_policy.finalize a = ok (finalize a) := by
  unfold account_policy.finalize finalize
  split <;> simp_all
  split <;> simp_all [max_def] <;> scalar_tac

/-- Every combined policy tightens both expiries, and never reduces either minimum. -/
theorem combine_bounds (a b : account_policy.Policy) :
    (combine a b).privilege_expiry ≤ a.privilege_expiry ∧
    (combine a b).privilege_expiry ≤ b.privilege_expiry ∧
    (combine a b).authsession_expiry ≤ a.authsession_expiry ∧
    (combine a b).authsession_expiry ≤ b.authsession_expiry ∧
    a.pw_min_length ≤ (combine a b).pw_min_length ∧
    b.pw_min_length ≤ (combine a b).pw_min_length ∧
    a.credential_policy ≤ (combine a b).credential_policy ∧
    b.credential_policy ≤ (combine a b).credential_policy := by
  simp [combine, min_le_left, min_le_right, le_max_left, le_max_right]

/-- A single false fallback policy survives every subsequent combination. -/
theorem fallback_false (a b : account_policy.Policy)
    (h : a.allow_primary_cred_fallback = some false ∨ b.allow_primary_cred_fallback = some false) :
    (combine a b).allow_primary_cred_fallback = some false := by
  rcases h with h | h <;> simp [combine, conjunction, h] <;>
    cases a.allow_primary_cred_fallback <;> cases b.allow_primary_cred_fallback <;> simp_all [conjunction]
@[step] theorem combine_wp (a b : account_policy.Policy) :
    account_policy.combine a b ⦃ r => r = combine a b ⦄ := by
  rw [combine_spec]
  simp

@[step] theorem finalize_wp (a : account_policy.Policy) :
    account_policy.finalize a ⦃ r => r = finalize a ⦄ := by
  rw [finalize_spec]
  simp

/-- The entire accumulation loop equals an independent list fold, at any valid index. -/
@[step] theorem fold_loop_spec (policies : Slice account_policy.Policy)
    (acc : account_policy.Policy) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ policies.val.length) :
    account_policy.fold_from_loop policies acc i
      ⦃ r => r = (policies.val.drop i.val).foldl combine acc ⦄ := by
  unfold account_policy.fold_from_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun x => policies.val.length - x.2.val)
    (inv := fun x => x.2.val ≤ policies.val.length ∧
      (policies.val.drop x.2.val).foldl combine x.1 =
      (policies.val.drop i.val).foldl combine acc)
  · rintro ⟨a,j⟩ ⟨hj,heq⟩
    by_cases hlt : j.val < policies.val.length
    · have hfold : (policies.val.drop j.val).foldl combine a =
          (policies.val.drop (j.val+1)).foldl combine (combine a policies.val[j.val]) := by
        rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt, List.foldl_cons]
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals (try simp_all)
      all_goals (try scalar_tac)
    · have hdrop : policies.val.drop j.val = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals (try simp_all)
      all_goals (try scalar_tac)
  · exact ⟨hi,rfl⟩

def initial : account_policy.Policy :=
  {privilege_expiry := 3600#u32, authsession_expiry := 4294967295#u32,
   pw_min_length := 10#u32, credential_policy := 0#u16,
   limit_search_max_filter_test := none, limit_search_max_results := none,
   allow_primary_cred_fallback := none}

/-- Complete scalar-policy result for arbitrary finite policy inputs. -/
theorem fold_from_spec (policies : Slice account_policy.Policy) :
    account_policy.fold_from policies
      ⦃ r => r = finalize (policies.val.foldl combine initial) ⦄ := by
  unfold account_policy.fold_from account_policy.initial
  h5i_steps
  all_goals (try simp_all [initial])
  all_goals rfl
end kanidm_kernel.Verified.AccountPolicy

Verified.CredentialCommit.code:
import KanidmKernel
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result kanidm_kernel
namespace kanidm_kernel.Verified.CredentialCommit

/-- The policy-specific warning; missing credentials is checked afterwards. -/
def policyWarning (policy : credential_commit.Policy) (primary : Option Bool)
    (passkeys attested : Bool) : Option credential_commit.Warning :=
  match policy with
  | .Any => none
  | .External | .Mfa => if primary = some false then some .MfaRequired else none
  | .Passkey => if primary.isSome then some .PasskeyRequired else none
  | .AttestedPasskey => if passkeys || primary.isSome then some .AttestedPasskeyRequired else none
  | .AttestedResidentkey => if attested || passkeys || primary.isSome then some .AttestedResidentKeyRequired else none
  | .Invalid => some .Unsatisfiable

def decision (policy : credential_commit.Policy) (primary : Option Bool)
    (passkeys attested : Bool) (caEmpty : Option Bool) : credential_commit.Decision :=
  let warning := policyWarning policy primary passkeys attested
  let missing := !attested && !passkeys && primary.isNone
  {can_commit := warning.isNone && !missing,
   policy_warning := warning,
   attestation_unsatisfiable := caEmpty.getD false,
   no_valid_credentials := warning.isNone && missing}

/-- Complete result, including warning order via the three distinct warning slots. -/
theorem can_commit_spec (policy : credential_commit.Policy) (primary : Option Bool)
    (passkeys attested : Bool) (caEmpty : Option Bool) :
    credential_commit.can_commit policy primary passkeys attested caEmpty =
      ok (decision policy primary passkeys attested caEmpty) := by
  cases policy <;> cases primary with
  | none => cases passkeys <;> cases attested <;> cases caEmpty <;>
      simp [credential_commit.can_commit, decision, policyWarning, core.option.Option.unwrap_or, lift] <;> rfl
  | some mfa => cases mfa <;> cases passkeys <;> cases attested <;> cases caEmpty <;>
      simp [credential_commit.can_commit, decision, policyWarning, core.option.Option.unwrap_or, lift] <;> rfl

/-- An invalid credential policy never allows a credential update to commit. -/
theorem invalid_denied (primary : Option Bool) (passkeys attested : Bool) (caEmpty : Option Bool) :
    ∃ d, credential_commit.can_commit .Invalid primary passkeys attested caEmpty = ok d ∧
      d.can_commit = false ∧ d.policy_warning = some .Unsatisfiable := by
  refine ⟨decision .Invalid primary passkeys attested caEmpty, can_commit_spec .., ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp [decision, policyWarning]
end kanidm_kernel.Verified.CredentialCommit

open Lean Elab Tactic Meta in
elab "join_protected_if" : tactic => withMainContext do
  let target ← instantiateMVars (← getMainTarget)
  let args := target.getAppArgs
  unless target.isAppOfArity ``Aeneas.Std.WP.spec 3 do
    throwError "expected a WP"
  let computation := args[1]!.consumeMData
  let ba := computation.getAppArgs
  let m ←
    if computation.isAppOfArity ``Bind.bind 6 then pure ba[4]!
    else if computation.isAppOfArity ``Aeneas.Std.bind 4 then pure ba[2]!
    else throwError "expected a bind"
  let m := m.consumeMData
  unless m.isAppOfArity ``ite 5 do throwError "expected a conditional"
  let mt ← inferType m
  let rt := mt.getAppArgs.back!
  let pair := rt.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2
  let vt := if pair then rt.getAppArgs[0]! else rt
  unless vt.isAppOfArity ``alloc.vec.Vec 1 do throwError "expected vector or vector pair"
  if pair then
    unless ← isDefEq vt rt.getAppArgs[1]! do throwError "expected homogeneous pair"
  let elem := vt.getAppArgs[0]!
  let counter ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
  let baseline ← IO.mkRef (#[] : Array Expr)
  m.forEach fun e => do
    let e := e.consumeMData
    if e.isAppOfArity ``bset.insert 2 || e.isAppOfArity ``migration.ins 2 then
      counter.modify (· + 1)
    if e.isFVar then
      let bases ← baseline.get
      if !bases.contains e then
        let et ← inferType e
        if ← isDefEq et vt then baseline.modify (·.push e)
  let count ← counter.get
  let bases ← baseline.get
  let mut bound := mkNatLit count
  for base in bases do
    let value ← mkAppM ``alloc.vec.Vec.val #[base]
    let len ← mkAppM ``List.length #[value]
    bound ← mkAppM ``Nat.add #[len, bound]
  let bsyntax ← Term.exprToSyntax bound
  let esyntax ← Term.exprToSyntax elem
  if pair then
    evalTactic (← `(tactic|
      apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun (r : alloc.vec.Vec $esyntax × alloc.vec.Vec $esyntax) =>
        r.1.val.length ≤ $bsyntax ∧ r.2.val.length ≤ $bsyntax)))
  else
    evalTactic (← `(tactic|
      apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun (r : alloc.vec.Vec $esyntax) => r.val.length ≤ $bsyntax)))
  let gs ← getGoals
  unless gs.length == 2 do throwError "expected two bind obligations"
  setGoals [gs.head!]
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| as_aux_lemma => total_steps))
  unless (← getGoals).isEmpty do throwError "conditional bound did not close"
  setGoals gs.tail!
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| intro joined joined_bound))

macro "protected_steps" : tactic => `(tactic| (
  have hmax := H5iAppLib.usize_max_ge
  repeat' (first
    | join_protected_if
    | step
    | split
    | (simp_all))
  all_goals (try simp_all)
  all_goals (try scalar_tac)))

-- Recursive filters are measured by their finite syntax trees.
theorem listN_member_size {α : Type} [SizeOf α] {n : Nat}
    (l : Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN α n) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l.toList) :
    sizeOf x < sizeOf l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.toList] at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.toList, List.mem_cons] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · simp only [Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.cons.sizeOf_spec]; omega
    · have := ih hx
      simp only [Aeneas.Data.ListN.ListN.cons.sizeOf_spec]; omega

theorem vec_member_size {α : Type} [SizeOf α] (v : alloc.vec.Vec α)
    (x : α) (hx : x ∈ v.val) : sizeOf x < sizeOf v := by
  have h := listN_member_size v.slice.list x hx
  cases v with
  | mk s =>
    cases s
    simp_all [alloc.vec.Vec.mk.sizeOf_spec, Slice.mk.sizeOf_spec]
    omega

@[step] theorem resolve_list_aux
    (vs : alloc.vec.Vec FilterComp) (ev : Identity) (i : Usize)
    (acc : alloc.vec.Vec FilterResolved)
    (hall : ∀ x ∈ vs.val, filter_impl.resolve_no_idx x ev ⦃ _ => True ⦄)
    (hi : i.val ≤ vs.val.length)
    (hacc : acc.val.length + (vs.val.length - i.val) ≤ Usize.max) :
    filter_impl.resolve_no_idx_list vs ev i acc ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  h5i_measure_induction (vs.val.length - i.val) with ih
  have hrec : ∀ (vs : alloc.vec.Vec FilterComp) (ev : Identity) (i : Usize)
      (acc : alloc.vec.Vec FilterResolved),
      (∀ x ∈ vs.val, filter_impl.resolve_no_idx x ev ⦃ _ => True ⦄) →
      i.val ≤ vs.val.length →
      acc.val.length + (vs.val.length - i.val) ≤ Usize.max →
      vs.val.length - i.val < k →
      filter_impl.resolve_no_idx_list vs ev i acc ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
    intro vs ev i acc hall hi hacc hlt
    exact ih _ hlt vs ev i acc hall hi hacc rfl
  clear ih
  rw [filter_impl.resolve_no_idx_list.eq_def]
  step*
  all_goals (try scalar_tac)
  all_goals (try (step with hall by simp))
  all_goals (repeat' (first | step | split))
  all_goals (try simp_all)
  all_goals (try scalar_tac)

@[step] theorem resolve_total (fc : FilterComp) (ev : Identity) :
    filter_impl.resolve_no_idx fc ev ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  induction hn : sizeOf fc using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing fc with
  | h n ih =>
    have hall : ∀ (vs : alloc.vec.Vec FilterComp), sizeOf vs < n →
        ∀ x ∈ vs.val, filter_impl.resolve_no_idx x ev ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
      intro vs hv x hx
      exact ih (sizeOf x) (by have := vec_member_size vs x hx; omega) x rfl
    have hrec : ∀ f : FilterComp, sizeOf f < n →
        filter_impl.resolve_no_idx f ev ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
      intro f hf
      exact ih _ hf f rfl
    clear ih
    rw [filter_impl.resolve_no_idx.eq_def]
    cases fc <;> total_steps
    all_goals (try (step with resolve_list_aux by
      first | (apply hall; simp_all) | scalar_tac))
    all_goals (try (step with hrec by simp_all))
    all_goals total_steps

-- Sum of the storage contributed by a table, including a remaining suffix.
def cost {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) (xs : List α) : Nat := (xs.map f).sum

@[simp] theorem cost_nil {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) : cost f [] = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem cost_cons {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    cost f (x :: xs) = f x + cost f xs := rfl
@[simp] theorem cost_append {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) (xs ys : List α) :
    cost f (xs ++ ys) = cost f xs + cost f ys := by
  simp [cost, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
theorem cost_drop_step {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) (xs : List α)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < xs.length) :
    cost f (xs.drop i) = f xs[i] + cost f (xs.drop (i + 1)) := by
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi, cost_cons]

theorem cost_mem {α : Type} (f : α → Nat) (xs : List α) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ xs) :
    f x ≤ cost f xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a xs ih =>
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
    simp only [cost_cons]
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · omega
    · have := ih hx; omega

def SrchBound (n : Nat) : AccessSrchResult → Prop
  | .Allow xs => xs.val.length ≤ n
  | _ => True

def ModBound (n : Nat) : AccessModResult → Prop
  | .Allow p r pc rc => p.val.length ≤ n ∧ r.val.length ≤ n ∧
      pc.val.length ≤ n ∧ rc.val.length ≤ n
  | .Constrain p r pc rc => p.val.length ≤ n ∧ r.val.length ≤ n ∧
      (∀ xs, pc = some xs → xs.val.length ≤ n) ∧
      (∀ xs, rc = some xs → xs.val.length ≤ n)
  | _ => True

attribute [simp, step_pre_simps, step_post_simps] SrchBound ModBound

macro "bounded_steps" : tactic => `(tactic| (
  total_steps
  all_goals (try simp_all [SrchBound, ModBound])
  all_goals h5i_steps
  all_goals (try simp_all [SrchBound, ModBound])
  all_goals (try scalar_tac)))

-- Summarize a conditional vector construction before continuing past its bind.
open Lean Elab Tactic Meta in
elab "join_vec_if" : tactic => withMainContext do
  let target ← instantiateMVars (← getMainTarget)
  let args := target.getAppArgs
  unless target.isAppOfArity ``Aeneas.Std.WP.spec 3 do
    throwError "expected a WP"
  let computation := args[1]!.consumeMData
  let ba := computation.getAppArgs
  let m ←
    if computation.isAppOfArity ``Bind.bind 6 then pure ba[4]!
    else if computation.isAppOfArity ``Aeneas.Std.bind 4 then pure ba[2]!
    else throwError "expected a bind"
  let m := m.consumeMData
  unless m.isAppOfArity ``ite 5 do throwError "expected a conditional"
  let mt ← inferType m
  let rt := mt.getAppArgs.back!
  let pair := rt.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2
  let vt := if pair then rt.getAppArgs[0]! else rt
  unless vt.isAppOfArity ``alloc.vec.Vec 1 do throwError "expected vector or vector pair"
  if pair then
    unless ← isDefEq vt rt.getAppArgs[1]! do throwError "expected homogeneous pair"
  let elem := vt.getAppArgs[0]!
  let counter ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
  let baseline ← IO.mkRef (#[] : Array Expr)
  m.forEach fun e => do
    let e := e.consumeMData
    if e.isAppOfArity ``bset.insert 2 || e.isAppOfArity ``migration.ins 2 then
      counter.modify (· + 1)
    if e.isFVar then
      let bases ← baseline.get
      if !bases.contains e then
        let et ← inferType e
        if ← isDefEq et vt then baseline.modify (·.push e)
  let count ← counter.get
  let bases ← baseline.get
  let mut bound := mkNatLit count
  for base in bases do
    let value ← mkAppM ``alloc.vec.Vec.val #[base]
    let len ← mkAppM ``List.length #[value]
    bound ← mkAppM ``Nat.add #[len, bound]
  let bsyntax ← Term.exprToSyntax bound
  let esyntax ← Term.exprToSyntax elem
  if pair then
    evalTactic (← `(tactic|
      apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun (r : alloc.vec.Vec $esyntax × alloc.vec.Vec $esyntax) =>
        r.1.val.length ≤ $bsyntax ∧ r.2.val.length ≤ $bsyntax)))
  else
    evalTactic (← `(tactic|
      apply WP.spec_bind (Pₘ := fun (r : alloc.vec.Vec $esyntax) => r.val.length ≤ $bsyntax)))
  let gs ← getGoals
  unless gs.length == 2 do throwError "expected two bind obligations"
  setGoals [gs.head!]
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| total_steps))
  unless (← getGoals).isEmpty do throwError "conditional bound did not close"
  setGoals gs.tail!
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| intro joined joined_bound))

macro "literal_steps" : tactic => `(tactic| (
  have hmax := H5iAppLib.usize_max_ge
  repeat' (first
    | join_vec_if
    | step
    | split
    | (simp_all))
  all_goals (try simp_all)
  all_goals (try scalar_tac)))

theorem search_start_spec (asr : AccessSrchResult) (n : Nat) (hb : SrchBound n asr)
    (hcap : n ≤ Usize.max) :
    (match asr with
    | .Deny => ok (true, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    | .Grant => ok (false, true, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    | .Ignore => ok (false, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    | .Allow attr => do
        let allow ← bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) attr.deref
        ok (false, false, allow))
    ⦃ r => r.2.2.val.length ≤ n ⦄ := by
  cases asr <;> bounded_steps

theorem search_merge_spec (asr : AccessSrchResult) (n : Nat) (hb : SrchBound n asr)
    (denied grant : Bool) (allow : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (hcap : allow.val.length + n ≤ Usize.max) :
    (match asr with
    | .Deny => ok (true, grant, allow)
    | .Grant => ok (denied, true, allow)
    | .Ignore => ok (denied, grant, allow)
    | .Allow attr => do
        let allow ← bset.extend allow attr.deref
        ok (denied, grant, allow))
    ⦃ r => r.2.2.val.length ≤ allow.val.length + n ⦄ := by
  cases asr <;> bounded_steps

  (entry : Entry) (hcap : cost resolvedSearchWeight related_acp.val + 18 ≤ Usize.max) :

  unfold search_acc.apply_search_access
  step as ⟨asr, hasr⟩
  apply WP.spec_bind (search_start_spec asr _ hasr (by omega))
  rintro ⟨denied, grant, allow⟩ hallow
  step as ⟨asr1, hasr1⟩

  step as ⟨asr2, hasr2⟩
  apply WP.spec_bind (search_merge_spec asr2 6 hasr2 denied1 grant1 allow1 (by simp_all; omega))
  rintro ⟨denied2, grant2, allow2⟩ hallow2
  step as ⟨asr3, hasr3⟩

import Verified.EntryValidationHelpers
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result kanidm_kernel
open Aeneas.Std.WP H5iAppLib
namespace kanidm_kernel.Verified.EntryValidation
set_option maxHeartbeats 600000
set_option maxRecDepth 4096

/-- The full error, including ordered payloads, independent of vector bounds. -/
inductive Outcome where
  | accepted | noClass | invalidClass (names : List U16)
  | supplements (names : List U16) | excludes (names : List U16)
  | corrupted | missing (names : List U16)
  | phantom (key : U16) | invalidAttribute (key : U16)
  | invalidSyntax (key : U16) | notAllowed (key : U16)
def outcome : core.result.Result Unit entry_validation.Error → Outcome
  | .Ok _ => .accepted
  | .Err .NoClassFound => .noClass
  | .Err (.InvalidClass xs) => .invalidClass xs.val
  | .Err (.SupplementsNotSatisfied xs) => .supplements xs.val
  | .Err (.ExcludesNotSatisfied xs) => .excludes xs.val
  | .Err .Corrupted => .corrupted
  | .Err (.MissingMustAttribute xs) => .missing xs.val
  | .Err (.PhantomAttribute k) => .phantom k
  | .Err (.InvalidAttribute k) => .invalidAttribute k
  | .Err (.InvalidAttributeSyntax k) => .invalidSyntax k
  | .Err (.AttributeNotValidForClass k) => .notAllowed k

/-- Complete ordered schema decision. Interned identifiers and the supplied
    ValueSet intrinsic-validity flag are the explicit port boundaries. -/
def validateModel (entry : entry_validation.Entry)
    (classes : List entry_validation.ClassSchema) (attrs : List entry_validation.AttributeSchema) : Outcome :=
  if !entry.class_present then .noClass else
  match entry.classes with
  | none => .noClass
  | some names =>
    if 0#u16 ∈ names.val then .accepted else
    let invalid := invalidClasses classes names.val
    if invalid ≠ [] then .invalidClass invalid else
    let supplements := constraintsModel classes names.val 0#u8
    if supplements ≠ [] ∧ ¬(supplements.any (fun k => decide (k ∈ names.val))) then
      .supplements supplements else
    let excluded := (constraintsModel classes names.val 1#u8).filter (fun k => decide (k ∈ names.val))
    if excluded ≠ [] then .excludes excluded else
    let must := constraintsModel classes names.val 2#u8
    if !schemaComplete attrs must then .corrupted else
    let missing := missingModel entry attrs must
    if missing ≠ [] ∧ ¬2#u16 ∈ names.val then .missing missing else
    if 1#u16 ∈ names.val then outcome (attributesModel entry.attrs.val attrs [] true) else
    let may := constraintsModel classes names.val 3#u8
    if !schemaComplete attrs may then .corrupted else
    outcome (attributesModel entry.attrs.val attrs may false)

/-- All collected class lists fit in a machine-sized vector. This is solely an
    allocation bound, not an assumption that validation succeeds. -/
def capacity (entry : entry_validation.Entry) (classes : List entry_validation.ClassSchema) : Prop :=
  match entry.classes with
  | none => True
  | some names => constraintsWeight classes names.val ≤ Usize.max

/-- Total decision, exact first error and ordered payload, for every input whose
    collected schema constraints fit in a machine-sized vector. -/
@[step] theorem validate_spec (entry : entry_validation.Entry)
    (classes : Slice entry_validation.ClassSchema) (attrs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema)
    (hcap : capacity entry classes.val) :
    entry_validation.validate entry classes attrs ⦃ r =>
      outcome r = validateModel entry classes.val attrs.val ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.validate
  cases hc : entry.class_present
  all_goals cases hn : entry.classes
  all_goals simp only [capacity, hn] at hcap
  all_goals h5i_steps
  all_goals try simp_all [validateModel, outcome, alloc.vec.Vec.new, UScalar.eq_equiv,
    Std.Array.empty]
  all_goals try grind

end kanidm_kernel.Verified.EntryValidation

@[simp, step_pre_simps, step_post_simps, scalar_tac_simps]
theorem deref_val {α : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) : v.deref.val = v.val := by
  simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]

@[step] theorem contains_loop_spec (xs : Slice U16) (key : U16) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val ≤ xs.length) :
    entry_validation.contains_loop xs key i ⦃ r => r = decide (key ∈ xs.val.drop i.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.contains_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun j => xs.length - j.val)
    (inv := fun j => j.val ≤ xs.length ∧
      (key ∈ xs.val.drop j.val ↔ key ∈ xs.val.drop i.val))
  · intro j hj
    by_cases hlt : j.val < xs.length
    · have hmem : key ∈ xs.val.drop i.val ↔ key = xs.val[j.val] ∨ key ∈ xs.val.drop (j.val+1) := by
        rw [← hj.2, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
        simp only [List.mem_cons]
      rcases hj with ⟨hj, _⟩
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all
      all_goals try scalar_tac
    · change ¬j.val < xs.val.length at hlt
      have hnone : ¬key ∈ xs.val.drop i.val := by
        rw [← hj.2, List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by omega : xs.val.length ≤ j.val)]
        simp
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all
      all_goals try scalar_tac
  · exact ⟨hi, Iff.rfl⟩

@[step] theorem attribute_index_loop_spec (xs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema)
    (key : U16) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ xs.length) :
    entry_validation.attribute_index_loop xs key i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, r = some j → j.val < xs.length) ∧
      r.bind (fun j => xs.val[j.val]?) = (xs.val.drop i.val).find? (fun a => a.key == key) ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.attribute_index_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun j => xs.length - j.val)
    (inv := fun j => j.val ≤ xs.length ∧
      (xs.val.drop j.val).find? (fun a => a.key == key) =
      (xs.val.drop i.val).find? (fun a => a.key == key))
  · intro j hj
    by_cases hlt : j.val < xs.length
    · have hfind : (xs.val.drop i.val).find? (fun a => a.key == key) =
          if xs.val[j.val].key == key then some xs.val[j.val] else
          (xs.val.drop (j.val+1)).find? (fun a => a.key == key) := by
        rw [← hj.2, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
        simp only [List.find?_cons]
        split <;> simp_all
      rcases hj with ⟨hj, _⟩
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all
      all_goals try scalar_tac
    · change ¬j.val < xs.val.length at hlt
      have hnone : (xs.val.drop i.val).find? (fun a => a.key == key) = none := by
        rw [← hj.2, List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by omega : xs.val.length ≤ j.val)]
        simp
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps

      · intro j h; cases h

theorem index_isSome (xs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (o : Option Usize)
    (hb : ∀ j, o = some j → j.val < xs.length) :
    (o.bind (fun j => xs.val[j.val]?)).isSome = o.isSome := by
  cases o with
  | none => rfl
  | some j => simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (hb j rfl)]

@[step] theorem attribute_index_spec (xs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (key : U16) :
    entry_validation.attribute_index xs key ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, r = some j → j.val < xs.length) ∧
      r.bind (fun j => xs.val[j.val]?) = xs.val.find? (fun a => a.key == key) ∧
      r.isSome = (xs.val.find? (fun a => a.key == key)).isSome ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.attribute_index
  apply WP.spec_mono (attribute_index_loop_spec xs key 0#usize (by simp))
  intro r hr
  have hs := congrArg Option.isSome hr.2
  rw [index_isSome xs r hr.1] at hs
  simpa using And.intro hr.1 (And.intro hr.2 hs)
def attributeModel (ava : entry_validation.Attribute)
    (attrs : List entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (may : List U16) (extensible : Bool) :
    core.result.Result Unit entry_validation.Error :=
  if extensible = false ∧ ava.key ∉ may then
    .Err (.AttributeNotValidForClass ava.key)
  else match attrs.find? (fun a => a.key == ava.key) with
    | none => .Err (if extensible then .InvalidAttribute ava.key else .Corrupted)
    | some a =>
      if extensible && a.phantom then .Err (.PhantomAttribute ava.key)
      else if (a.multi = true ∨ ava.count.val ≤ 1) ∧ a.syntax = ava.syntax ∧ ava.valid = true then
        .Ok () else .Err (.InvalidAttributeSyntax ava.key)

@[step] theorem ava_spec (multi : Bool) (count : Usize) (expected actual : U16) (valid : Bool) :
    schema_tags.ava_accepts multi count expected actual valid ⦃ r =>
      r = decide ((multi = true ∨ count.val ≤ 1) ∧ expected = actual ∧ valid = true) ⦄ := by
  cases multi <;> cases valid <;> by_cases hc : count > 1#usize <;> by_cases he : expected = actual <;>
    simp_all [schema_tags.ava_accepts] <;> (try simp_all) <;> (try split) <;> (try simp_all) <;> (try omega)

/-- Complete attribute decision, including first matching schema and error precedence. -/
@[step] theorem validate_attribute_spec (ava : entry_validation.Attribute)
    (attrs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (may : Slice U16) (extensible : Bool) :
    entry_validation.validate_attribute ava attrs may extensible ⦃ r =>
      r = attributeModel ava attrs.val may.val extensible ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.validate_attribute
  cases extensible <;> h5i_steps
  all_goals try simp_all [attributeModel]
  all_goals (rw [←o_post1] <;> simp_all)
def attributesModel (avas : List entry_validation.Attribute)
    (attrs : List entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (may : List U16) (extensible : Bool) :
    core.result.Result Unit entry_validation.Error :=
  match avas with
  | [] => .Ok ()
  | a::rest => match attributeModel a attrs may extensible with
      | .Ok () => attributesModel rest attrs may extensible
      | .Err e => .Err e

@[step] theorem validate_attributes_loop_spec (entry : entry_validation.Entry)
    (attrs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (may : Slice U16) (extensible : Bool)
    (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ entry.attrs.val.length) :
    entry_validation.validate_attributes_loop entry attrs may extensible i ⦃ r =>
      r = attributesModel (entry.attrs.val.drop i.val) attrs.val may.val extensible ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.validate_attributes_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun j => entry.attrs.val.length - j.val)
    (inv := fun j => j.val ≤ entry.attrs.val.length ∧
      attributesModel (entry.attrs.val.drop j.val) attrs.val may.val extensible =
      attributesModel (entry.attrs.val.drop i.val) attrs.val may.val extensible)
  · intro j hj
    by_cases hlt : j.val < entry.attrs.val.length
    · have hstep : attributesModel (entry.attrs.val.drop i.val) attrs.val may.val extensible =
          match attributeModel entry.attrs.val[j.val] attrs.val may.val extensible with
          | .Ok () => attributesModel (entry.attrs.val.drop (j.val+1)) attrs.val may.val extensible
          | .Err e => .Err e := by
        rw [←hj.2, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
        rfl
      rcases hj with ⟨hj,_⟩
      cases hm : attributeModel entry.attrs.val[j.val] attrs.val may.val extensible
      all_goals h5i_unfold_body
      all_goals h5i_steps
      all_goals simp_all
      all_goals try scalar_tac
    · have hnone : attributesModel (entry.attrs.val.drop i.val) attrs.val may.val extensible = .Ok () := by
        rw [←hj.2, List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by omega)]
        rfl
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all
      all_goals try scalar_tac
  · exact ⟨hi,rfl⟩

/-- Every attribute is checked in upstream order, returning the first complete error. -/
@[step] theorem validate_attributes_spec (entry : entry_validation.Entry)
    (attrs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (may : Slice U16) (extensible : Bool) :
    entry_validation.validate_attributes entry attrs may extensible ⦃ r =>
      r = attributesModel entry.attrs.val attrs.val may.val extensible ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.validate_attributes
  h5i_steps
  simp_all
def schemaComplete (attrs : List entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (names : List U16) : Bool :=
  names.all (fun key => (attrs.find? (fun a => a.key == key)).isSome)

@[step] theorem schema_complete_loop_spec (attrs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema)
    (names : Slice U16) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ names.val.length) :
    entry_validation.schema_complete_loop attrs names i ⦃ r =>
      r = schemaComplete attrs.val (names.val.drop i.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.schema_complete_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun j => names.val.length - j.val)
    (inv := fun j => j.val ≤ names.val.length ∧
      schemaComplete attrs.val (names.val.drop j.val) = schemaComplete attrs.val (names.val.drop i.val))
  · intro j hj
    by_cases hlt : j.val < names.val.length
    · have hstep : schemaComplete attrs.val (names.val.drop i.val) =
          ((attrs.val.find? (fun a => a.key == names.val[j.val])).isSome &&
          schemaComplete attrs.val (names.val.drop (j.val+1))) := by
        rw [←hj.2, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
        rfl
      rcases hj with ⟨hj,_⟩
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all [Option.isSome_iff_ne_none, Option.isSome_eq_isSome]
      all_goals try scalar_tac
    · have hnone : schemaComplete attrs.val (names.val.drop i.val) = true := by
        rw [←hj.2, List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by omega)]
        rfl
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all
      all_goals try scalar_tac

@[step] theorem schema_complete_spec (attrs : Slice entry_validation.AttributeSchema) (names : Slice U16) :

@[step] theorem append_loop_spec (out : alloc.vec.Vec U16) (xs : Slice U16) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val ≤ xs.val.length)
    (hcap : out.val.length + (xs.val.length-i.val) ≤ Usize.max) :

    · have hnone : xs.val.drop j.val = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by change ¬j.val < xs.val.length at hlt; omega)
      h5i_unfold_body

@[step] theorem append_spec (out : alloc.vec.Vec U16) (xs : Slice U16)

def classModel (c : entry_validation.ClassSchema) (kind : U8) : List U16 :=

def classWeight (c : entry_validation.ClassSchema) : Nat :=

theorem classIndex_isSome (xs : Slice entry_validation.ClassSchema) (o : Option Usize)
    (hb : ∀ j, o = some j → j.val < xs.length) :
    (o.bind (fun j => xs.val[j.val]?)).isSome = o.isSome := by
  cases o with

@[step] theorem class_index_spec (xs : Slice entry_validation.ClassSchema) (key : U16) :
    entry_validation.class_index xs key ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, r = some j → j.val < xs.length) ∧
      r.bind (fun j => xs.val[j.val]?) = xs.val.find? (fun a => a.key == key) ∧

def invalidClasses (classes : List entry_validation.ClassSchema) (names : List U16) : List U16 :=
  names.filter (fun key => (classes.find? (fun c => c.key == key)).isNone)

@[step] theorem invalid_classes_loop_spec (classes : Slice entry_validation.ClassSchema)
    (names : Slice U16) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U16) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val ≤ names.val.length)
    (hcap : out.val.length + (names.val.length-i.val) ≤ Usize.max) :
    entry_validation.invalid_classes_loop classes names out i ⦃ r =>
      r.val = out.val ++ invalidClasses classes.val (names.val.drop i.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.invalid_classes_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun x => names.val.length-x.2.val)
    (inv := fun x => x.2.val ≤ names.val.length ∧
      x.1.val ++ invalidClasses classes.val (names.val.drop x.2.val) =
        out.val ++ invalidClasses classes.val (names.val.drop i.val) ∧
      x.1.val.length + (names.val.length-x.2.val) ≤ Usize.max)
  · rintro ⟨o,j⟩ ⟨hj,heq,hc⟩
    by_cases hlt : j.val < names.val.length
    · have hstep : out.val ++ invalidClasses classes.val (names.val.drop i.val) =
          if (classes.val.find? (fun c => c.key == names.val[j.val])).isNone then
            (o.val ++ [names.val[j.val]]) ++ invalidClasses classes.val (names.val.drop (j.val+1))
          else o.val ++ invalidClasses classes.val (names.val.drop (j.val+1)) := by
        rw [←heq, List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hlt]
        simp only [invalidClasses, List.filter_cons]
        split <;> simp_all [List.append_assoc]
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all [Option.isSome_eq_isSome, Option.isSome_iff_ne_none]
      all_goals try scalar_tac
    · have hnone : names.val.drop j.val = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by omega)
      h5i_unfold_body
      h5i_steps
      all_goals try simp_all [invalidClasses]
      all_goals try scalar_tac
  · exact ⟨hi,rfl,hcap⟩

@[step] theorem invalid_classes_spec (classes : Slice entry_validation.ClassSchema) (names : Slice U16) :
    entry_validation.invalid_classes classes names ⦃ r => r.val = invalidClasses classes.val names.val ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.invalid_classes
  have hlen := names.property
  h5i_steps
  simp_all

theorem classModel_length (c : entry_validation.ClassSchema) (kind : U8) :
    (classModel c kind).length ≤ classWeight c := by
  unfold classModel classWeight
  split
  · simp only [List.length_append]; omega
  · split
    · simp only [List.length_append]; omega
    · split <;> simp only [List.length_append, List.length_nil] <;> omega

def constraintsModel (classes : List entry_validation.ClassSchema) (names : List U16)
    (kind : U8) : List U16 :=
  names.flatMap (fun key => match classes.find? (fun c => c.key == key) with
    | none => [] | some c => classModel c kind)
def constraintsWeight (classes : List entry_validation.ClassSchema) (names : List U16) : Nat :=
  (names.map (fun key => match classes.find? (fun c => c.key == key) with
    | none => 0 | some c => classWeight c)).sum

@[step] theorem constraints_loop_spec (classes : Slice entry_validation.ClassSchema)
    (names : Slice U16) (kind : U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U16) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val ≤ names.val.length)
    (hcap : out.val.length + constraintsWeight classes.val (names.val.drop i.val) ≤ Usize.max) :
    entry_validation.constraints_loop classes names kind out i ⦃ r =>
      r.val = out.val ++ constraintsModel classes.val (names.val.drop i.val) kind ⦄ := by
  unfold entry_validation.constraints_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun x => names.val.length-x.2.val)
    (inv := fun x => x.2.val ≤ names.val.length ∧
      x.1.val ++ constraintsModel classes.val (names.val.drop x.2.val) kind =

@[step] theorem bytes_eq_spec (a b : Slice U8) :
    bset.bytes_eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a.val = b.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold bset.bytes_eq
  by_cases hl : a.length = b.length
  · have hl' : a.val.length = b.val.length := by simpa using hl
    simp only [Slice.len, bne_iff_ne, ne_eq]
    split

    · unfold bset.bytes_eq_loop
      apply WP.spec_mono (H5iAppLib.loop_search (List.zip a.val b.val) (fun p => p.1 != p.2) id
        (fun _ _ => false) true _ ?step 0#usize (by simp))
      · intro r hr

        have h := H5iAppLib.search_all _ _ _ hr
        rw [h, ← zip_all_eq _ _ hl']

theorem all_entries_ok (ident : Identity) (acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlDeleteResolved)

    (fun i => ∀ k (hk : k < es.val.length), k < i.val → delete_acc.apply_delete_access ident acp es.val[k] = ok .Grant)
    (fun b => b = true → ∀ k (hk : k < es.val.length), delete_acc.apply_delete_access ident acp es.val[k] = ok .Grant)
    ?_ 0#usize true (by simp) (by simp) h rfl
  intro x r hI hx hr
  unfold access.delete_all_entries_loop.body at hr
  h5i_invert hr
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨hxl, hxe⟩ := slice_index_ok he

    simp only [id]
    refine ⟨fun k hk hk2 => ?_, by simp at hi2v ⊢; omega, by simp at hi2v ⊢; omega⟩

    · have : k = x.val := by simp at hi2v; omega

theorem classes_safe (e : Entry) (s : Slice U8) (hs : s.val = [99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8])

  try simp only at h

    search_acc.search_filter_entry ident related_acp entry = ok AccessSrchResult.Deny := by
  unfold search_acc.search_filter_entry
  rcases hs with (⟨⟨u, hu⟩, hscope⟩ | ⟨s, hs⟩)
  · simp [hu, identity_impl.access_scope, hscope]
  · simp [hs]

lemma step_denied (asr : AccessSrchResult) (s s' : Bool × Bool × alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
    (h_denied : s.1 = true)
    (h : (match asr with
      | AccessSrchResult.Deny => ok (true, s.2.1, s.2.2)
      | AccessSrchResult.Grant => ok (s.1, true, s.2.2)
      | AccessSrchResult.Ignore => ok (s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2)
      | AccessSrchResult.Allow attr => do
        let allow2 ← bset.extend s.2.2 attr.deref
        ok (s.1, s.2.1, allow2)) = ok s') :
    s'.1 = true := by
  cases asr with
  | Deny => simp at h; subst h; rfl
  | Grant => simp at h; subst h; exact h_denied
  | Ignore => simp at h; subst h; exact h_denied
  | Allow attr =>
    obtain ⟨allow2, -, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    simp at h; subst h; exact h_denied

lemma apply_search_access_deny (ident : Identity) (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlSearchResolved)
    (entry : Entry) (sr : search_acc.SearchResult)
    (hs : (IsUser ident ∧ ident.scope = .Synchronise) ∨ ∃ s, ident.origin = .Synch s)
    (h : search_acc.apply_search_access ident related_acp entry = ok sr) :
    sr = search_acc.SearchResult.Deny := by
  unfold search_acc.apply_search_access at h
  rw [search_filter_entry_deny ident related_acp entry hs] at h
  simp at h
  obtain ⟨asr1, -, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  have hs1_denied : s1.1 = true := step_denied asr1 (true, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new _) s1 rfl hs1
  obtain ⟨asr2, -, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  have hs2_denied : s2.1 = true := step_denied asr2 s1 s2 hs1_denied hs2
  obtain ⟨asr3, -, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  obtain ⟨s3, hs3, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  have hs3_denied : s3.1 = true := step_denied asr3 s2 s3 hs2_denied hs3
  rcases s3 with ⟨denied3, grant3, allow3⟩
  simp [show denied3 = true from hs3_denied] at h
  exact h.symm

lemma filter_entries_loop_body_step (ident : Identity)
    (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlSearchResolved)
    (requested_attrs : Slice (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    (entries : Slice Entry)
    (hs : (IsUser ident ∧ ident.scope = .Synchronise) ∨ ∃ s, ident.origin = .Synch s)
    (x : alloc.vec.Vec Entry × Std.Usize)
    (hinv : x.1.val = []) :
    ∀ r, access.filter_entries_loop_loop.body ident related_acp requested_attrs entries x.1 x.2 = ok r →
    match r with
    | .done y => y.val = []
    | .cont x' => x'.1.val = [] ∧ entries.val.length - x'.2.val < entries.val.length - x.2.val := by
  intro r hbody
  cases r with
  | done y =>
    unfold access.filter_entries_loop_loop.body at hbody
    by_cases hlt : (x.2 < entries.len)
    · simp [hlt] at hbody
      obtain ⟨e, -, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      obtain ⟨e1, -, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      obtain ⟨sr, hsr, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      have hsr_deny := apply_search_access_deny ident related_acp e1 sr hs hsr
      subst hsr_deny
      obtain ⟨keep, hkeep, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      simp at hkeep
      subst hkeep
      obtain ⟨allowed_entries1, hallowed, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      simp at hallowed
      subst hallowed
      obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hbody
      contradiction
    · simp [hlt] at hbody
      subst hbody
      exact hinv
  | cont x' =>
    unfold access.filter_entries_loop_loop.body at hbody
    by_cases hlt : (x.2 < entries.len)
    · simp [hlt] at hbody
      obtain ⟨e, -, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      obtain ⟨e1, -, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      obtain ⟨sr, hsr, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      have hsr_deny := apply_search_access_deny ident related_acp e1 sr hs hsr
      subst hsr_deny
      obtain ⟨keep, hkeep, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      simp at hkeep
      subst hkeep
      obtain ⟨allowed_entries1, hallowed, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      simp at hallowed
      subst hallowed
      obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hbody
      simp only [ok.injEq] at hbody
      injection hbody with hbody
      subst hbody
      refine ⟨hinv, ?_⟩
      have hadd := @UScalar.add_equiv .Usize x.2 1#usize
      rw [hi2] at hadd
      have : x.2.val < entries.val.length := by scalar_tac
      have : i2.val = x.2.val + 1 := by simp [hadd.2.1]
      dsimp only
      omega
    · simp [hlt] at hbody

theorem synchronise_sees_nothing (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ident : Identity) (f : FilterComp)
    (es : Slice Entry) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Entry)
    (hs : (IsUser ident ∧ ident.scope = .Synchronise) ∨ ∃ s, ident.origin = .Synch s)
    (h : access.filter_entries ctl ident f es = ok (.Ok out)) :
    out.val = [] := by
  unfold access.filter_entries at h
  obtain ⟨requested_attrs, -, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  by_cases hi : (requested_attrs.len = 0#usize)
  · simp [hi] at h
    subst h
    rfl
  · simp [hi] at h
    obtain ⟨related_acp, -, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    obtain ⟨v, hv, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    simp only [ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] at h
    subst h
    unfold access.filter_entries_loop access.filter_entries_loop_loop at hv
    refine loop_ok
      (body := fun p => access.filter_entries_loop_loop.body ident related_acp.deref requested_attrs.deref es p.1 p.2)
      (Inv := fun p => p.1.val = [])
      (Q := fun y => y.val = [])
      (μ := fun p => es.val.length - p.2.val)
      ?_
      (alloc.vec.Vec.new Entry, 0#usize)
      v
      rfl
      hv
    intro ⟨ae, i⟩ r hinv hbody
    have hstep := filter_entries_loop_body_step ident related_acp.deref requested_attrs.deref es hs (ae, i) hinv r hbody
    cases r with
    | done y => exact hstep
    | cont x' => exact hstep

end kanidm_kernel.Verified.KanidmSynchroniseSeesNothing
